proxy.meaning: Any sparse witness, containment, nearest-shell, or radial-excess value is a proxy and is not a physical penetration depth.

surfaceIntersection.method: Blender BVHTree.overlap on complete exported triangles, per semantic node
surfaceIntersection.coordinateNote: Blender importer maps glTF Y-up (x,y,z) to Blender (x,-z,y)

topology.method: independent coordinate weld plus edge incidence on Blender-imported triangles
